items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: They had Peter Bocard. And there was a lot of dissension in the band. Peter Bocard was the leader...

ctx.x: These were the excursion boats, not the Password? The excursion boats, yeah. Not the Password.

Yeah, excursion boats. Somewhere when I got here in 48, they dropped us off in St. Louis and I was supposed to come back. But Piedhorn went with the band out there and the captain got discouraged. I forgot to repeat that. They had Peter Bocard. And there was a lot of dissension in the band. Peter Bocard was the leader and the Tramble Brothers was supposed to be the manager and they both came over the river and there was a lot of dissension. I could see and feel it. So when I went to Chicago, like I said, the…
What was it like playing on the boats? I mean, from what I heard, you know, I heard like one thing there were a lot of fights on the boats.
